<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt;">We may elect to prepay the Loans, in whole or in part, in cash, plus an applicable prepayment and/or make-whole premium. Under certain circumstances, we are required to prepay all or a portion of the outstanding Loans, plus an applicable prepayment and/or make-whole premium, as described below.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman"; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 26pt;">(1)   If, on November 1, 2025, (i) the aggregate outstanding principal amount of the outstanding 2026 Notes that is not held by the Lenders equals or exceeds $<ix:nonFraction id="c729" contextRef="i_2025-11-01_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember_StatementScenarioAxis-ScenarioForecastMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:DebtInstrumentCovenantMinimumPrincipalAmountRequiredToTriggerPrepayment" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">38.5</ix:nonFraction> million and (ii) we have not made or delivered notice that we expect to make certain voluntary or mandatory prepayments under the Credit Agreement of at least $<ix:nonFraction id="c730" contextRef="i_2025-11-01_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember_StatementScenarioAxis-ScenarioForecastMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:DebtInstrumentCovenantMandatoryPrepayment" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-7">20.0</ix:nonFraction> million in the aggregate, then we would be required, on or prior to November 15, 2025, to make a $<ix:nonFraction id="c731" contextRef="i_2025-11-01_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember_StatementScenarioAxis-ScenarioForecastMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:DebtInstrumentCovenantMandatoryPrepayment" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-7">20.0</ix:nonFraction> million mandatory prepayment, together with a $<ix:nonFraction id="c732" contextRef="i_2025-11-01_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember_StatementScenarioAxis-ScenarioForecastMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:DebtInstrumentCovenantPrepaymentPremium" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-6">1.0</ix:nonFraction> million prepayment premium.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman"; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 26pt;">(2)   Upon the occurrence of a change in control, we must prepay the entire outstanding amount of the Loans, plus the applicable make-whole or prepayment premium.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman"; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 26pt;">(3)   We must prepay the Loans in an amount equal to: (i) <ix:nonFraction id="c733" contextRef="i_2024-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember" unitRef="Pure" name="omer:DebtInstrumentPrepaymentPercentageOfMilestonePaymentsReceived" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">25.0</ix:nonFraction>% of any milestone payments received from DRI or its affiliates on the basis of net sales of OMIDRIA; (ii) <ix:nonFraction id="c734" contextRef="i_2024-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember" unitRef="Pure" name="omer:DebtInstrumentPrepaymentPercentageOfCashProceedsFromSaleOrLicenseOfAssets" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="1">60.0</ix:nonFraction>% of the net cash proceeds (excluding transaction expenses and certain milestone payments) received by Omeros from the sale or license of our assets (or in the case of an asset sale or license involving narsoplimab that occurs while any Delayed Draw Term Loan is outstanding, an amount equal to <ix:nonFraction id="c735" contextRef="i_2024-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember_ProductOrServiceAxis-NarsoplimabMember" unitRef="Pure" name="omer:DebtInstrumentPrepaymentPercentageOfCashProceedsFromSaleOrLicenseOfAssets" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="0">100</ix:nonFraction>% of the net cash proceeds from such transaction); (iii) <ix:nonFraction id="c736" contextRef="i_2024-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember" unitRef="Pure" name="omer:DebtInstrumentPrepaymentPercentageOfCashProceedsFromIndebtedness" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="0">100.0</ix:nonFraction>% of net cash proceeds of indebtedness incurred by the Company other than as permitted by the Credit Agreement; and (iv) <ix:nonFraction id="c737" contextRef="i_2024-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember" unitRef="Pure" name="omer:DebtInstrumentPrepaymentPercentageOfNetCashProceedsFromInsuranceRecoveries" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="0">100</ix:nonFraction>% of the net cash proceeds of insurance recoveries on loss of property, except to the extent utilized to repair or replace the relevant assets within a specified time.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt;">Voluntary and mandatory prepayments of the Loans are subject to payment of the following premiums: (i) during the first year of such Loans, a make-whole premium plus <ix:nonFraction id="c738" contextRef="i_2024-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember" unitRef="Pure" name="omer:DebtInstrumentPrepaymentsAnnualPrepaymentPercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">5.0</ix:nonFraction>% of the applicable prepayment amount (unless the prepayment is made in contemplation of a change of control, in which case only the make-whole premium would be payable); (ii) during the second year, a prepayment premium equal to <ix:nonFraction id="c739" contextRef="i_2025-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember_StatementScenarioAxis-ScenarioForecastMember" unitRef="Pure" name="omer:DebtInstrumentPrepaymentsAnnualPrepaymentPercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">5.0</ix:nonFraction>% of the applicable prepayment amount; and (iii) during the third year, a prepayment premium equal to <ix:nonFraction id="c740" contextRef="i_2026-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember_StatementScenarioAxis-ScenarioForecastMember" unitRef="Pure" name="omer:DebtInstrumentPrepaymentsAnnualPrepaymentPercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">3.0</ix:nonFraction>% of the applicable prepayment amount.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt;">The Credit Agreement contains certain customary default provisions, representations and warranties and affirmative and negative covenants. These include a covenant requiring us to maintain at all times unrestricted cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments of at least $<ix:nonFraction id="c741" contextRef="i_2024-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:DebtInstrumentCovenantRequiredUnrestrictedCash" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-6">25.0</ix:nonFraction> million in accounts subject to control agreements and a covenant limiting the use of cash for open market or privately negotiated repurchases of any outstanding 2026 Notes to: (i) an initial amount not exceeding $<ix:nonFraction id="c742" contextRef="i_2024-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:DebtInstrumentCovenantOpenMarketTransactionsMaximumAmountOfInitialCash" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-6">25.0</ix:nonFraction> million, which may be increased by up to an additional $<ix:nonFraction id="c743" contextRef="i_2024-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:DebtInstrumentCovenantOpenMarketTransactionsConditionalAdditionalAmount" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-7">10.0</ix:nonFraction> million subject to the satisfaction of certain conditions; (ii) an unlimited amount, if the amount of the Loans outstanding at the time of repurchase does not exceed $<ix:nonFraction id="c744" contextRef="i_2024-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:DebtInstrumentCovenantOpenMarketTransactionsUnlimitedThreshold" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">38.5</ix:nonFraction> million; and (iii) an additional amount not to exceed <ix:nonFraction id="c745" contextRef="i_2024-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember" unitRef="Pure" name="omer:DebtInstrumentCovenantOpenMarketTransactionsMaximumAdditionalAmountPercentageOfProceedsFromEquityOffering" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="1">50</ix:nonFraction>% of the net cash proceeds from an equity offering, provided that the Company offers to prepay an equal amount of the Loans with the net cash proceeds of such offering. As of December 31, 2024, the Company was in compliance with the covenants under the Credit Agreement. After review of the customary default provisions, affirmative and negative covenants, and voluntary and mandatory prepayment options, we determined that the net derivative asset was not significant as of December 31, 2024. A default under the Credit Agreement that results in the outstanding debt thereunder being declared due and payable prior to the stated maturity would constitute a cross-default under the indenture governing the 2026 Notes. In such an event, the principal and all accrued and unpaid interest on the 2026 Notes may be declared immediately due and payable either by the trustee under the indenture, or by the holders of at least <ix:nonFraction id="c746" contextRef="i_2024-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember" unitRef="Pure" name="omer:DebtInstrumentDefaultDeclaredPayableInFullPercentageOfHoldersOfDebt" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">25</ix:nonFraction>% of the aggregate principal amount of the 2026 Notes outstanding.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt;">The fair value of the Loans is classified as a Level 3 liability. As of December 31, 2024, the approximate fair value of our Loan obligations was $<ix:nonFraction id="c747" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:LongTermDebtFairValue" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">69.5</ix:nonFraction> million. We determined the fair market value by discounting the future cash flows based on adjusted SOFR at each measurement date.</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt;"><b><i>2023 Unsecured Convertible Senior Notes</i></b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt;">We extinguished the $<ix:nonFraction id="c748" contextRef="d_2023-11-15_2023-11-15_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2023Member" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:ExtinguishmentOfDebtAmount" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-6">95.0</ix:nonFraction> million outstanding on our 2023 Notes at par upon maturity on November 15, 2023. <p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt;"><b><i>2026 Unsecured Convertible Senior Notes</i></b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt;">We have outstanding unsecured convertible senior notes which accrue interest at an annual rate of <ix:nonFraction id="c758" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="4">5.25</ix:nonFraction>% per annum, payable semi-annually in arrears on February 15 and August 15 of each year. The 2026 Notes mature on February 15, 2026, unless earlier purchased, redeemed or converted in accordance with their terms.</p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt;">In 2024, we repurchased $<ix:nonFraction id="c759" contextRef="d_2024-06-03_2024-06-03_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOf2026NotesIntoNewTermLoansMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtConversionOriginalDebtAmount1" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">118.1</ix:nonFraction> million of principal amount outstanding on our 2026 Notes for a total aggregate repurchase price of $<ix:nonFraction id="c760" contextRef="d_2024-06-03_2024-06-03_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOf2026NotesIntoNewTermLoansMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:RepaymentsOfDebt" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">88.8</ix:nonFraction> million (approximately <ix:nonFraction id="c761" contextRef="d_2024-06-03_2024-06-03_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOf2026NotesIntoNewTermLoansMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentRedemptionPricePercentageOfPrincipalAmountRedeemed" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">75</ix:nonFraction>% of par value), using proceeds from the Initial Term Loan of $<ix:nonFraction id="c762" contextRef="d_2024-06-03_2024-06-03_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOf2026NotesIntoNewTermLoansMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentAmount1" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">67.1</ix:nonFraction> million and paying $<ix:nonFraction id="c763" contextRef="d_2024-06-03_2024-06-03_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOf2026NotesIntoNewTermLoansMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:PaymentsOfDebtRestructuringCosts" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">21.7</ix:nonFraction> million of cash on hand.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt;">The conversion rate is <ix:nonFraction id="c784" contextRef="d_2024-01-01_2024-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionRatio1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">54.0906</ix:nonFraction> shares of our common stock per $<ix:nonFraction id="c785" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member" unitRef="USD" name="omer:DebtInstrumentConvertibleDebtDenominatorAmount" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="0">1,000</ix:nonFraction> of note principal (equivalent to an initial conversion price of approximately $<ix:nonFraction id="c786" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionPrice1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">18.4875</ix:nonFraction> per share of common stock), which equals approximately <ix:nonFraction id="c787" contextRef="d_2024-01-01_2024-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member" unitRef="Share" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleNumberOfEquityInstruments" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">5.3</ix:nonFraction> million shares issuable upon conversion, subject to adjustment in certain circumstances.</p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt;"> </p>

<p style="text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; margin: 0pt; font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The 2026 Notes are convertible at the option of the holders on or after November 15, 2025 at any time prior to the close of business on February 12, 2026, the second scheduled trading day immediately before the stated maturity date of February 15, 2026. Additionally, holders may convert their 2026 Notes at their option at specified times prior to the maturity date only if:</p>

<p style="text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; margin: 0pt; font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> </p>

<p style="text-align: left; text-indent: 0pt; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 26pt; font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">(1)   during any calendar quarter, the last reported sale price per share of our common stock exceeds <ix:nonFraction id="c788" contextRef="d_2024-01-01_2024-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member_StatementScenarioAxis-DebtConversionAfterSeptember302020Member" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdPercentageOfStockPriceTrigger" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="1">130</ix:nonFraction>% of the conversion price of the 2026 Notes for each of at least <ix:nonFraction id="c789" contextRef="d_2024-01-01_2024-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member_StatementScenarioAxis-DebtConversionOnOrAfterAugust152023Member" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdTradingDays" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">20</ix:nonFraction> trading days in the period of <ix:nonFraction id="c790" contextRef="d_2024-01-01_2024-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member_StatementScenarioAxis-DebtConversionOnOrAfterAugust152023Member" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdConsecutiveTradingDays1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">30</ix:nonFraction> consecutive trading days ending on, and including, the last trading day of the immediately preceding calendar quarter; </p>

<p style="text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; margin: 0pt; font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> </p>

<p style="text-align: left; text-indent: 0pt; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 26pt; font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">(2)   during the <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c791">five</span> consecutive business days immediately after any <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c792">five</span>-consecutive-trading-day period (such <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c793">five</span>-consecutive-trading-day period, the “measurement period”) in which the trading price per $<ix:nonFraction id="c794" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member_StatementScenarioAxis-DebtConversionAfterSeptember302020Member" unitRef="USD" name="omer:DebtInstrumentConvertibleDebtDenominatorAmount" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="0">1,000</ix:nonFraction> principal amount of 2026 Notes for each trading day of the measurement period was less than <ix:nonFraction id="c795" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member_StatementScenarioAxis-DebtConversionAfterSeptember302020Member" unitRef="Pure" name="omer:DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdSalePriceOfCommonStockConversionRateProductPercentageMaximum" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">98</ix:nonFraction>% of the product of the last reported sale price per share of our common stock on such trading day and the conversion rate on such trading day;</p>

<p style="text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; margin: 0pt; font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> </p>

<p style="text-align: left; text-indent: 0pt; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 26pt; font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">(3)   there is an occurrence of one or more certain corporate events or distributions of our common stock; or </p>

<p style="text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; margin: 0pt; font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> </p>

<p style="text-align: left; text-indent: 0pt; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 26pt; font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">(4)   we call the 2026 Notes for redemption.</p>

<p style="text-align: left; text-indent: 0pt; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 26pt; font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> </p>

<p style="text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; margin: 0pt; font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">We will settle any conversions by paying or delivering, as applicable, cash, shares of our common stock or a combination of cash and shares of our common stock, at our election, based on the applicable conversion rate(s).</p>

<p style="text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; margin: 0pt; font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> </p>

<p style="text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; margin: 0pt; font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Subject to the satisfaction of certain conditions, we may redeem in whole or in part the 2026 Notes at our option beginning August 15, 2023 through the 50th scheduled trading day immediately before the maturity date at a cash redemption price equal to the principal amount of the 2026 Notes to be redeemed plus any accrued and unpaid interest. The 2026 Notes are subject to redemption only if certain requirements are satisfied, including that the last reported sale price per share of our common stock exceeds <ix:nonFraction id="c796" contextRef="d_2024-01-01_2024-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member_StatementScenarioAxis-DebtConversionOnOrAfterAugust152023Member" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdPercentageOfStockPriceTrigger" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="1">130</ix:nonFraction>% of the conversion price on (i) each of at least 20 trading days, whether or not consecutive, during the 30 consecutive trading days ending on, and including, the trading day immediately before the date we send the related redemption notice and (ii) the trading day immediately before the date we send such notice.</p>

<p style="text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; margin: 0pt; font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> </p>

<p style="text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; margin: 0pt; font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">In order to reduce the dilutive impact or potential cash expenditure associated with the conversion of the 2026 Notes, we entered into capped call transactions in connection with the issuances of the 2026 Notes (the "2026 Capped Call"). The 2026 Capped Call will cover, subject to anti-dilution adjustments substantially similar to those applicable to the 2026 Notes, the number of shares of common stock underlying the 2026 Notes when our common stock is trading within the range of $<ix:nonFraction id="c797" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2026CappedCallMember_RangeAxis-MinimumMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionPrice1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">18.49</ix:nonFraction> and $<ix:nonFraction id="c798" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2026CappedCallMember_RangeAxis-MaximumMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionPrice1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">26.10</ix:nonFraction>. However, should the market price of our common stock exceed the $<ix:nonFraction id="c799" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2026CappedCallMember_RangeAxis-MaximumMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionPrice1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">26.10</ix:nonFraction> cap, then the conversion of the 2026 Notes would have an additional dilutive impact or may require a cash expenditure to the extent the market price exceeds the cap price. The 2026 Capped Call will expire on various dates over the <ix:nonFraction id="c800" contextRef="d_2024-01-01_2024-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2026CappedCallMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdTradingDays" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">50</ix:nonFraction>-trading-day period ranging from December 2, 2025 to February 12, 2026, if not exercised earlier. The 2026 Capped Call is a separate transaction and not part of the terms of the 2026 Notes and was executed separately from the issuance of the 2026 Notes. The amount paid for the 2026 Capped Call was recorded as a reduction to additional paid-in capital in the consolidated balance sheet. As of December 31, 2024, approximately <ix:nonFraction id="c801" contextRef="d_2024-01-01_2024-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2026CappedCallMember" unitRef="Share" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleNumberOfEquityInstruments" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">12.2</ix:nonFraction> million shares remained outstanding under the 2026 Capped Call. We also retain all potential future value of the capped call purchased in connection with the issuance of the 2026 Notes covering all shares underlying the original 2026 Notes.</p>

<p style="text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; margin: 0pt; font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> </p>

<p style="text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; margin: 0pt; font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Further, we concluded the 2026 Capped Call qualifies for a derivative scope exception for instruments that are both indexed to an entity’s own stock and classified in stockholders’ equity in its balance sheet. Consequently, the fair value of the 2026 Capped Call of $<ix:nonFraction id="c802" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2026CappedCallMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:DebtInstrumentConvertibleFairValueAmountOfEquityComponent" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">23.2</ix:nonFraction> million is classified as equity, not accounted for as derivatives, and will not be subsequently remeasured.</p>

<p style="text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; margin: 0pt; font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> </p>

<p style="text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; margin: 0pt; font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b><i>Minimum Commitments</i></b></p>

<p style="text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; margin: 0pt; font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> </p>

<p style="text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt; margin: 0pt; font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">As of December 31, 2024, the most probable principal payments on our 2026 Notes and Term Loan are as follows:</p>

<p style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: "Times New Roman"; margin: 0pt;"><b>Note</b> 7—<b>Discontinued Operations - Sale of OMIDRIA</b></p>

<p style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: "Times New Roman"; margin: 0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt;">On December 23, 2021, we sold the rights to OMIDRIA and related assets to Rayner, which is reported as discontinued operations in our consolidated statements of operations and comprehensive income (loss) and excluded from continuing operations for all periods presented. </p>

<p style="text-indent: 9pt; font-size: 10pt; font-family: "Times New Roman"; margin: 0pt;"> </p>

<p style="text-indent: 18pt; font-size: 10pt; font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">In December 2022, we earned a $<ix:nonFraction id="c898" contextRef="i_2022-12-29_DisposalGroupClassificationAxis-DiscontinuedOperationsDisposedOfBySaleMember_IncomeStatementBalanceSheetAndAdditionalDisclosuresByDisposalGroupsIncludingDiscontinuedOperationsAxis-OmidriaAssetsDisposalMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:MilestonePaymentReceivableFromSaleOfRoyaltyUnderAssetPurchaseAgreement" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-8">200.0</ix:nonFraction> million Milestone Payment upon the occurrence of an event specified in the Asset Purchase Agreement with Rayner. The Milestone Payment was received in February 2023. The Milestone Event also resulted in a reduction in the U.S. royalty rate from <ix:nonFraction id="c899" contextRef="d_2021-12-23_2021-12-23_DisposalGroupClassificationAxis-DiscontinuedOperationsDisposedOfBySaleMember_IncomeStatementBalanceSheetAndAdditionalDisclosuresByDisposalGroupsIncludingDiscontinuedOperationsAxis-OmidriaAssetsDisposalMember" unitRef="Pure" name="omer:PercentageOfRoyaltyReceivableOnSaleOfProductRights" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="1">50</ix:nonFraction>% to <ix:nonFraction id="c900" contextRef="d_2022-12-29_2022-12-29_DisposalGroupClassificationAxis-DiscontinuedOperationsDisposedOfBySaleMember_IncomeStatementBalanceSheetAndAdditionalDisclosuresByDisposalGroupsIncludingDiscontinuedOperationsAxis-OmidriaAssetsDisposalMember" unitRef="Pure" name="omer:PercentageOfRoyaltyReceivableOnSaleOfProductRights" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="1">30</ix:nonFraction>% on OMIDRIA net sales. </p>

<p style="text-indent: 9pt; font-size: 10pt; font-family: "Times New Roman"; margin: 0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">The results of operations for OMIDRIA are recorded as income from discontinued operations for all periods presented in the consolidated statements of operations and comprehensive income (loss) are as follows:</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt;">Net cash provided by discontinued operations primarily represents royalties received and the $<ix:nonFraction id="c934" contextRef="i_2022-12-29_DisposalGroupClassificationAxis-DiscontinuedOperationsDisposedOfBySaleMember_IncomeStatementBalanceSheetAndAdditionalDisclosuresByDisposalGroupsIncludingDiscontinuedOperationsAxis-OmidriaAssetsDisposalMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:MilestonePaymentReceivableFromSaleOfRoyaltyUnderAssetPurchaseAgreement" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-8">200.0</ix:nonFraction> million milestone payment that we collected from Rayner in February 2023. <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2024-01-01_2024-12-31" name="omer:RoyaltyObligationTextBlock" id="c974" escape="true">
<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Note</b> 8—<b>OMIDRIA Royalty Obligation</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">In September 2022, we sold to DRI an interest in our future OMIDRIA royalty receipts and received $<ix:nonFraction id="c976" contextRef="d_2022-09-30_2022-09-30_CounterpartyNameAxis-DRIHealthcareAcquisitionLpMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:ProceedsFromRoyaltyObligation" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-6">125.0</ix:nonFraction> million in cash consideration which was recorded as an OMIDRIA royalty obligation on our consolidated balance sheet. DRI was entitled to receive royalties on OMIDRIA net sales between September 1, 2022 and December 31, 2030 up to certain annual cap limits.</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">In February 2024, Omeros and DRI expanded their royalty purchase agreement under the Amendment, resulting in the elimination of previously existing annual caps on royalty payments and Omeros receiving an additional $<ix:nonFraction id="c977" contextRef="d_2024-02-01_2024-02-29_CounterpartyNameAxis-DRIHealthcareAcquisitionLpMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:ProceedsFromRoyaltyObligation" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">115.5</ix:nonFraction> million in cash consideration which we accounted for as a modification of our existing debt from DRI. All royalties earned on OMIDRIA sales within the U.S. through December 31, 2031 are remitted by Rayner to an escrow account established by Omeros, from which payments are made to DRI. </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">We retain the right to receive all royalties payable by Rayner on any U.S. net sales of OMIDRIA after December 31, 2031 and all royalties on global net sales of OMIDRIA from and after December 31, 2031. To date, international royalties have not been significant. DRI has no recourse to our assets other than in its interest in OMIDRIA royalties.</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt;">We are also entitled to receive a milestone payment ranging between $<ix:nonFraction id="c978" contextRef="d_2024-02-01_2024-02-29_CounterpartyNameAxis-DRIHealthcareAcquisitionLpMember_RangeAxis-MinimumMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:MilestoneBenchmarkOneIfMilestoneAchieves" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-7">10.0</ix:nonFraction> million and $<ix:nonFraction id="c979" contextRef="d_2024-02-01_2024-02-29_CounterpartyNameAxis-DRIHealthcareAcquisitionLpMember_RangeAxis-MaximumMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:MilestoneBenchmarkOneIfMilestoneAchieves" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">27.5</ix:nonFraction> million if U.S. net sales of OMIDRIA reach applicable thresholds ranging between a total of $<ix:nonFraction id="c980" contextRef="d_2024-02-01_2024-02-29_CounterpartyNameAxis-DRIHealthcareAcquisitionLpMember_RangeAxis-MinimumMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:MilestoneBenchmarkTwoIfMilestoneAchieves" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-6">156.0</ix:nonFraction> million and $<ix:nonFraction id="c981" contextRef="d_2024-02-01_2024-02-29_CounterpartyNameAxis-DRIHealthcareAcquisitionLpMember_RangeAxis-MaximumMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:MilestoneBenchmarkTwoIfMilestoneAchieves" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-7">160.0</ix:nonFraction> million for any period of four consecutive quarters prior to January 1, 2026. In addition, we are entitled to receive a separate milestone payment ranging between $<ix:nonFraction id="c982" contextRef="d_2024-02-01_2024-02-29_CounterpartyNameAxis-DRIHealthcareAcquisitionLpMember_RangeAxis-MinimumMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:MilestoneBenchmarkThreeMinimumNetSalesRequiredForFourConsecutiveQuarters" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-6">8.0</ix:nonFraction> million and $<ix:nonFraction id="c983" contextRef="d_2024-02-01_2024-02-29_CounterpartyNameAxis-DRIHealthcareAcquisitionLpMember_RangeAxis-MaximumMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:MilestoneBenchmarkThreeMinimumNetSalesRequiredForFourConsecutiveQuarters" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">27.5</ix:nonFraction> million if U.S. net sales of OMIDRIA reach applicable thresholds ranging between a total of $<ix:nonFraction id="c984" contextRef="d_2024-02-01_2024-02-29_CounterpartyNameAxis-DRIHealthcareAcquisitionLpMember_RangeAxis-MinimumMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:MilestoneBenchmarkFourMinimumNetSalesRequiredForFourConsecutiveQuarters" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-6">181.0</ix:nonFraction> million and $<ix:nonFraction id="c985" contextRef="d_2024-02-01_2024-02-29_CounterpartyNameAxis-DRIHealthcareAcquisitionLpMember_RangeAxis-MaximumMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:MilestoneBenchmarkFourMinimumNetSalesRequiredForFourConsecutiveQuarters" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-6">185.0</ix:nonFraction> million for any period of four consecutive quarters prior to January 1, 2028.</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">The OMIDRIA royalty obligation is classified as a Level 3 liability as its valuation requires substantial judgment and estimation of factors that are not currently observable in the market. The fair value of the OMIDRIA royalty obligation is determined by calculating the net present value of our estimated future OMIDRIA cash flows using the interest rate at inception of our royalty purchase agreement with DRI, adjusted for the change in the prime rate through the remeasurement date. As of December 31, 2024, the approximate fair value of our obligation was $<ix:nonFraction id="c993" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_FairValueByFairValueHierarchyLevelAxis-FairValueInputsLevel3Member_FairValueByLiabilityClassAxis-RoyaltyObligationMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:LiabilitiesFairValueDisclosure" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">209.7</ix:nonFraction> million.</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Note</b> <b>9</b>—<b>Lease Liabilities</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">We have operating leases related to our office and laboratory space. The initial term of the leases is through November 2027 and we have <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c1053">two</span> options to extend the lease term, each by <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c1054">five</span> years. <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Note</b> <b>10</b>—<b>Commitments and Contingencies</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 11pt;"><i>Contracts</i></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">We have various agreements with third parties that collectively require payment of termination fees totaling $<ix:nonFraction id="c1213" contextRef="i_2024-12-31" unitRef="USD" name="omer:LongtermPurchaseCommitmentTerminationFee" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">4.7</ix:nonFraction> million as of December 31, 2024 if we cancel the work within specific time frames, either prior to commencing or during performance of the contracted services.</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;"><i>Development Milestones and Product Royalties</i></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">We have entered a variety of development, collaboration, licensing or similar agreements with third parties under which we have accessed technology or services in connection with our development assets and programs. Some of these agreements require milestone payments based on achievements of development, regulatory or sales milestones, and/or low-single to low-double digit royalties on net income or net sales of the relevant product. For the year ended December 31, 2024, we did <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c1214">not</span> pay any development milestones. For the years ended December 31, 2023 and 2022, we paid $<ix:nonFraction id="c1215" contextRef="i_2023-12-31_ProductOrServiceAxis-LicenseMember_TypeOfArrangementAxis-DevelopmentMilestonesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:AccruedLiabilitiesCurrentAndNoncurrent" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-6">5.0</ix:nonFraction> million and $<ix:nonFraction id="c1216" contextRef="i_2022-12-31_ProductOrServiceAxis-LicenseMember_TypeOfArrangementAxis-DevelopmentMilestonesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:AccruedLiabilitiesCurrentAndNoncurrent" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">0.3</ix:nonFraction> million, respectively in development milestones. </p>
</ix:nonNumeric>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline; ">Amendment of 2017 Omnibus Incentive Compensation Plan</span> - At our June 23, 2023 annual meeting, our shareholders approved a <ix:nonFraction id="c1223" contextRef="d_2023-06-23_2023-06-23_PlanNameAxis-OmnibusIncentiveCompensationPlanMember" unitRef="Share" name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfAdditionalSharesAuthorized" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">5,000,000</ix:nonFraction> share increase in the number of shares of common stock available for grant under the 2017 Omnibus Incentive Compensation Plan, as amended and restated.</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline; ">Share Repurchase Program</span> - On November 9, 2023, the Board of Directors approved a share repurchase program under which we were permitted to repurchase from time to time up to $<ix:nonFraction id="c1224" contextRef="i_2023-11-09_ShareRepurchaseProgramAxis-IndefiniteTermShareRepurchaseProgramMember" unitRef="USD" name="srt:StockRepurchaseProgramAuthorizedAmount1" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-7">50.0</ix:nonFraction> million of our common stock in the open market or through privately negotiated transactions. For the year ended December 31, 2023, we repurchased and retired <ix:nonFraction id="c1225" contextRef="d_2023-01-01_2023-12-31_ShareRepurchaseProgramAxis-IndefiniteTermShareRepurchaseProgramMember" unitRef="Share" name="us-gaap:StockRepurchasedAndRetiredDuringPeriodShares" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">1.8</ix:nonFraction> million shares of common stock at an average price of $<ix:nonFraction id="c1226" contextRef="d_2023-01-01_2023-12-31_ShareRepurchaseProgramAxis-IndefiniteTermShareRepurchaseProgramMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="us-gaap:TreasuryStockAcquiredAverageCostPerShare" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">2.54</ix:nonFraction> per share for an aggregate purchase price of $<ix:nonFraction id="c1227" contextRef="d_2023-01-01_2023-12-31_ShareRepurchaseProgramAxis-IndefiniteTermShareRepurchaseProgramMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:StockRepurchasedAndRetiredDuringPeriodValue" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">4.7</ix:nonFraction> million. During the first quarter of 2024, we repurchased and retired <ix:nonFraction id="c1228" contextRef="d_2024-01-01_2024-03-31_ShareRepurchaseProgramAxis-IndefiniteTermShareRepurchaseProgramMember" unitRef="Share" name="us-gaap:StockRepurchasedAndRetiredDuringPeriodShares" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">3.2</ix:nonFraction> million shares of common stock at an average of $<ix:nonFraction id="c1229" contextRef="d_2024-01-01_2024-03-31_ShareRepurchaseProgramAxis-IndefiniteTermShareRepurchaseProgramMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="us-gaap:TreasuryStockAcquiredAverageCostPerShare" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">3.71</ix:nonFraction> per share for an aggregate purchase price of $<ix:nonFraction id="c1230" contextRef="d_2024-01-01_2024-03-31_ShareRepurchaseProgramAxis-IndefiniteTermShareRepurchaseProgramMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:StockRepurchasedAndRetiredDuringPeriodValue" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">11.9</ix:nonFraction> million. The terms of the Credit Agreement prohibit us from repurchasing our common stock unless expressly agreed to by the Lenders. Consequently, the Board of Directors terminated the share repurchase program effective upon execution the Credit Agreement in June 2024.</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Note</b> <b>12</b>—<b>Stock-Based Compensation</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">Our equity plans provide for the grant of incentive and non-statutory stock options, stock appreciation rights, restricted stock awards, restricted stock units, performance units, performance shares and other stock and cash awards to employees and consultants. Stock options are granted with an exercise price not less than the fair market value of Omeros’ common stock on the date of the grant. Any unexercised options expire <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2024-01-01_2024-12-31_AwardTypeAxis-EmployeeStockOptionMember" name="us-gaap:SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardExpirationPeriod" id="c1238" format="ixt-sec:duryear">10</ix:nonNumeric> years from grant date, and any unvested stock options granted which are subsequently canceled become available for future reissuance.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">For the year ended December 31, 2024, for federal and state income tax purposes, we have net income from continuing operations and from discontinued operations. For the years ended December 31, 2023 and 2022, we had net losses from continuing operations and net income from discontinued operations. At December 31, 2024, 2023 and 2022, we had federal net operating loss (“NOL”) carryforwards of approximately $<ix:nonFraction id="c1405" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-DomesticCountryMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:OperatingLossCarryforwards" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">331.7</ix:nonFraction> million, $<ix:nonFraction id="c1406" contextRef="i_2023-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-DomesticCountryMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:OperatingLossCarryforwards" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">398.6</ix:nonFraction> million and $<ix:nonFraction id="c1407" contextRef="i_2022-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-DomesticCountryMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:OperatingLossCarryforwards" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">361.4</ix:nonFraction> million, respectively. At December 31, 2024, 2023 and 2022, we had state NOL carryforwards of approximately $<ix:nonFraction id="c1408" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-StateAndLocalJurisdictionMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:OperatingLossCarryforwards" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">233.2</ix:nonFraction> million, $<ix:nonFraction id="c1409" contextRef="i_2023-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-StateAndLocalJurisdictionMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:OperatingLossCarryforwards" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">245.8</ix:nonFraction> million and $<ix:nonFraction id="c1410" contextRef="i_2022-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-StateAndLocalJurisdictionMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:OperatingLossCarryforwards" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">226.3</ix:nonFraction> million, respectively. In 2024 and 2022, we had net income for federal income tax purposes. Therefore, we utilized existing NOLs of $<ix:nonFraction id="c1411" contextRef="d_2024-01-01_2024-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-DomesticCountryMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:OperatingLossCarryforwardsUtilized" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">62.5</ix:nonFraction> million and $<ix:nonFraction id="c1412" contextRef="d_2022-01-01_2022-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-DomesticCountryMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:OperatingLossCarryforwardsUtilized" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">268.6</ix:nonFraction> million, respectively, to fully offset our federal tax liability for both periods. In 2023, we had a net loss for federal income tax purposes and <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c1413">no</span> federal tax liability. We recorded state income tax expense of $<ix:nonFraction id="c1414" contextRef="d_2024-01-01_2024-12-31_DisposalGroupClassificationAxis-DiscontinuedOperationsDisposedOfBySaleMember_IncomeStatementBalanceSheetAndAdditionalDisclosuresByDisposalGroupsIncludingDiscontinuedOperationsAxis-OmidriaAssetsDisposalMember_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-StateAndLocalJurisdictionMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DiscontinuedOperationTaxEffectOfDiscontinuedOperation" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">0.3</ix:nonFraction> million, $<ix:nonFraction id="c1415" contextRef="d_2023-01-01_2023-12-31_DisposalGroupClassificationAxis-DiscontinuedOperationsDisposedOfBySaleMember_IncomeStatementBalanceSheetAndAdditionalDisclosuresByDisposalGroupsIncludingDiscontinuedOperationsAxis-OmidriaAssetsDisposalMember_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-StateAndLocalJurisdictionMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DiscontinuedOperationTaxEffectOfDiscontinuedOperation" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">0.5</ix:nonFraction> million and $<ix:nonFraction id="c1416" contextRef="d_2022-01-01_2022-12-31_DisposalGroupClassificationAxis-DiscontinuedOperationsDisposedOfBySaleMember_IncomeStatementBalanceSheetAndAdditionalDisclosuresByDisposalGroupsIncludingDiscontinuedOperationsAxis-OmidriaAssetsDisposalMember_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-StateAndLocalJurisdictionMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DiscontinuedOperationTaxEffectOfDiscontinuedOperation" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-6">4.0</ix:nonFraction> million in discontinued operations in 2024, 2023 and 2022, respectively, as we did not have adequate NOLs and tax credits to fully offset our state tax liability.</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">Deferred income tax assets and liabilities reflect the tax effect of NOL and tax credit carryforwards and the net temporary difference between the carrying amounts of assets and liabilities for financial reporting purposes and the amounts used for income tax purposes.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">As of December 31, 2024, we had federal NOL carryforwards of approximately $<ix:nonFraction id="c1447" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-DomesticCountryMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:OperatingLossCarryforwards" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">331.7</ix:nonFraction> million and state NOL carryforwards of approximately $<ix:nonFraction id="c1448" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-StateAndLocalJurisdictionMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:OperatingLossCarryforwards" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">233.2</ix:nonFraction> million. Pre-2018 federal NOLs of $<ix:nonFraction id="c1449" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-DomesticCountryMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:OperatingLossCarryforwardsSubjectToExpiration" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">45.2</ix:nonFraction> million expire between 2035 and 2037. Post-2018 federal NOLs of $<ix:nonFraction id="c1450" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-DomesticCountryMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:OperatingLossCarryforwardsNotSubjectToExpiration" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">286.5</ix:nonFraction> million do not expire. Research and development tax credit carryforwards of $<ix:nonFraction id="c1451" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_TaxCreditCarryforwardAxis-ResearchMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:TaxCreditCarryforwardAmount" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">104.9</ix:nonFraction> million expire between 2025 and 2044.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">The Tax Cuts and Jobs Act was enacted on December 22, 2017 and includes the requirement to capitalize and amortize research and experimental expenditures beginning in 2022. Prior to 2022, we expensed these costs as incurred for tax purposes. </p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b><a id="item9" title="item9" href="#"></a>ITEM</b> <b>9.</b>              <b>CHANGES IN AND DISAGREEMENTS WITH ACCOUNTANTS ON ACCOUNTING AND FINANCIAL DISCLOSURE</b></p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">None.</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b><a id="item9a" title="item9a" href="#"></a>ITEM</b> <b>9A.</b>            <b>CONTROLS AND PROCEDURES</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Disclosure Controls and Procedures</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">Our management, with the participation of our principal executive officer and principal financial officer, evaluated the effectiveness of our disclosure controls and procedures, as defined in Rules 13a-15(e) and 15d-15(e) under the Exchange Act, as of December 31, 2024. Management recognizes that any controls and procedures, no matter how well designed and operated, can provide only reasonable assurance of achieving their objectives, and management necessarily applies its judgment in evaluating the cost-benefit relationship of possible controls and procedures. Based on the evaluation of our disclosure controls and procedures as of December 31, 2024, our principal executive and principal financial officers concluded that, as of such date, our disclosure controls and procedures were effective at the reasonable assurance level.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Management</b>’<b>s Report on Internal Control Over Financial Reporting</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">Our management is responsible for establishing and maintaining adequate internal control over financial reporting, as such term is defined in Exchange Act Rules 13a-15(f) and 15d-15(f). Internal control over financial reporting is a process designed to provide reasonable assurance regarding the reliability of financial reporting and the preparation of financial statements for external purposes in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">Internal control over financial reporting cannot provide absolute assurance of achieving financial reporting objectives because of its inherent limitations. Internal control over financial reporting is a process that involves human diligence and compliance and is subject to lapses in judgment and breakdowns resulting from human failures. Internal control over financial reporting also can be circumvented by collusion or improper management override. Because of such limitations, there is a risk that material misstatements may not be prevented or detected on a timely basis by internal control over financial reporting. However, these inherent limitations are known features of the financial reporting process. Therefore, it is possible to design into the process safeguards to reduce, though not eliminate, this risk.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">Our management, with the participation of our principal executive and principal financial officers, conducted an assessment of the effectiveness of our internal control over financial reporting as of December 31, 2024. In making this assessment, management used the criteria set forth by the Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission in Internal Control-Integrated Framework (2013 framework). Based on the results of this assessment and on those criteria, our management concluded that our internal control over financial reporting was effective as of December 31, 2024.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>
